clamp.contract: Return value bounded inclusively by low and high; inputs are finite numbers with low <= high.
clamp.reference_code: function clamp_value(value, low, high) { return Math.min(high, Math.max(low, value)); }
clamp.starter_code: function clamp_value(value, low, high) { return Math.max(high, Math.max(low, value)); }
clamp.correct_code: function clamp_value(value, low, high) { if (value < low) return low; if (value > high) return high; return value; }
clamp.wrong_code: function clamp_value(value, low, high) { return Math.max(low, value); }

positives.contract: Sum only strictly positive finite numbers from an array. Empty input returns 0.
positives.reference_code: function sum_positive(values) { return values.filter(x => x > 0).reduce((a,b) => a+b, 0); }
positives.starter_code: function sum_positive(values) { return values.filter(x => x < 0).reduce((a,b) => a+b, 0); }
positives.correct_code: function sum_positive(values) { let total = 0; for (const x of values) { if (x > 0) total += x; } return total; }
positives.wrong_code: function sum_positive(values) { return values.reduce((a,b) => a + Math.abs(b), 0); }

age.contract: For a nonnegative integer age, return adult for age >= 18, otherwise minor.

divide.contract: Divide finite numbers a by b. Return null when b is zero, including when a is also zero.
divide.reference_code: function safe_divide(a,b) { if (b === 0) return null; return a/b; }
divide.starter_code: function safe_divide(a,b) { if (b === 0) return 0; return a/b; }
divide.correct_code: function safe_divide(a,b) { return b !== 0 ? a / b : null; }
divide.wrong_code: function safe_divide(a,b) { if (a === 0 || b === 0) return null; return a/b; }
